title: Base prompt → storyboard/image generation → prompt refinement → Seedance 2.0…
content:
Base prompt → storyboard/image generation → prompt refinement → Seedance 2.0 video node şeklinde bir pipeline kurarak fikirden görsele, görselden videoya kontrollü ilerle  
Renoise AI Canvas içinde node’ları birbirine bağlayıp Seedance 2.0 video node’u en sona koyarak önce storyboard/görsel üret, sonra prompt’u rafine edip videoya geç
tips:

en.content:
By setting up a pipeline in the form of base prompt → storyboard/image generation → prompt refinement → Seedance 2.0 video node, progress from idea to visual, and from visual to video in a controlled manner.  
Within the Renoise AI Canvas, connect the nodes to each other and place the Seedance 2.0 video node at the end to first produce the storyboard/image, then refine the prompt and move on to video.

fr.content:
---
Base prompt → génération de storyboard/image → raffinement du prompt → établir un pipeline sous la forme d'un nœud vidéo Seedance 2.0 pour avancer de manière contrôlée de l'idée à l'image, de l'image à la vidéo  
Dans Renoise AI Canvas, connectez les nœuds entre eux et placez le nœud vidéo Seedance 2.0 à la fin pour d'abord produire le storyboard/l'image, puis affiner le prompt et passer à la vidéo  
---

ja.content:
---
Base prompt → storyboard/image generation → prompt refinement → Seedance 2.0 video node という形でパイプラインを構築し、アイデアからビジュアルへ、ビジュアルからビデオへとコントロールされた進行を行う  
Renoise AI Canvas 内でノードを互いに接続し、Seedance 2.0 video node を最後に配置して、まずストーリーボード/ビジュアルを生成し、その後プロンプトを洗練してビデオに移行する  
---

ko.content:
---
Base prompt → storyboard/image generation → prompt refinement → Seedance 2.0 video node 형태로 파이프라인을 구축하여 아이디어에서 이미지로, 이미지에서 비디오로 통제된 진행  
Renoise AI Canvas 안에서 노드들을 서로 연결하고 Seedance 2.0 video node를 맨 끝에 배치하여 먼저 스토리보드/이미지를 생성하고, 그 후 prompt를 정제하여 비디오로 전환  
---

Dentro do Renoise AI Canvas, conecte os nodes e coloque o node de vídeo Seedance 2.0 no final para primeiro produzir o storyboard/visual, depois refine o prompt e passe para o vídeo
